## Method

Subjects were profiled from public search snippets so a classifier can tell them from namesakes: Nidhi Hooda is the founder of Growpido LLC, a reputation advisory based in Dubai, U.A.E. She is described as building the reputation of DIFC leaders and CEOs and as a reputation architect. Growpido says it focuses on executive reputation, narrative architecture, and strategic influence for founders, fund managers, and executives. The company is listed as a marketing services business headquartered in Dubai. Mentions came from web and news searches; LinkedIn results were kept as search engine snippets and never fetched, nothing behind a login was read. Every mention was classified by gpt-5.4-mini; anything not a confident ignore was classified again by gpt-5.6-terra. The final label follows fixed rules: respond now needs both to agree, any disagreement or any doubt about identity is marked ambiguous and held for a human. Nobody was contacted.
